name: What If At 2:14
description:
What if your building's group chat saw someone at your door — and you didn't?

Short animated "what if" horror stories, all set in one building: Elm Court.
Every night starts at 2:14 a.m. New story every night.

All stories, names and apartments are fiction. Don't watch alone.
keywords: what if, horror shorts, scary stories, animated horror, group chat horror, creepy texts, 3am stories, elm court, horror animation
